title: Respect a creator canvas correction instead of snapping back to repo defaults
starting_state: A creator first asks for a carousel, then corrects the request to one square proof only.
A workflow component still generates native 3:4 and 9:16 outputs from defaults.
done_when: Format inference locks the latest creator correction.
The system asks for the exact canvas when the correction is ambiguous.
No unrequested Story/Reel or carousel outputs are generated.
forbidden_changes: Do not remove native 1080x1440 or 1080x1920 final requirements.
Do not make square the default format.
fail_to_pass: latest creator correction to one square proof wins over carousel/story defaults
pass_to_pass: native 1080x1440 post and 1080x1920 story/reel requirements remain defaults when explicitly requested
anti_gaming_notes: Hidden checker should assert the latest prompt correction wins over repo defaults.
